title: fix(runtime): a signed-in request reads its session once when an authentication policy is on
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgRuogP8Tp8XyFXLc92Bxvo6)_

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZiaBg6rk7dpy1s9Me

Part of #35457 — this lands the gate half (the ADR-0069 gate and the declared-endpoint policy chain stop re-reading a session the identity step already read). The inbound rate limiter's read stays, because sharing it needs a per-request carrier in the HTTP transport, outside this claim's file surface (see Acceptance notes).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

1. 开启了登录安全策略（密码过期、强制多因素认证、管理员要求改密）的部署上，已登录用户的每次平台请求和应用自定义接口请求，少读一次会话和用户记录，托管环境每次请求省两次远程数据库往返；放行与拦截结果不变。
2. 这是托管云「页面要九到十秒才能打开」提速工作的阻塞项之一。
3. 出错的话，受登录安全策略约束的用户可能被错误放行或拦截；直接撤回这次合并即可恢复原状。
4. 无

## What changes

Re-measured at `origin/main` 97f342037d on a real kernel (sqlite-wasm, real `AuthPlugin`, Bearer session, warm), getSession calls / `sys_session`-by-token statements per authenticated request:

| composition | dispatcher route (`/api/v1/packages`, `/i18n/locales`) | REST route (`/api/v1/data/...`) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| default (no gate feature, no rate limit) | 1 | 1 |
| ADR-0069 gate active | **2** (identity step + `HttpDispatcher.enforceAuthGate`, `http-dispatcher.ts:1665`) | 2 (identity + core `decideAuthGate` re-read) |
| `server.security.rateLimit` armed | **2** (limiter `resolve-session-principal.ts:64`, via `dispatcher-plugin.ts:911`) + identity | 2 |
| both | 3 | 3 |
| declared app endpoint (fallback), gate active | 3 (identity + `resolvePrincipalId` + `readGatedSessionUser`) | n/a |

Each getSession costs the session's token lookup, the session user's row and the grants resolution behind `customSession`.

- `security/admitting-credential.ts`: `sessionAdmittedPrincipal(request)` — the user id and ADR-0069 posture the identity step recorded off the request's OWN session read (`context.admission` + the resolved envelope). `undefined` for an anonymous caller, an API key, an OAuth access token or forward credential, and an identity step that degraded after the read; each of those keeps the read it had.
- `HttpDispatcher.enforceAuthGate`: after the `isAuthGateActive()` probe, a session-admitted principal is judged by that posture — no second read. The carrier is the existing per-request `HttpProtocolContext`; nothing is cached across requests.
- `dispatcher-plugin.ts` declared-endpoint fallback: `resolvePrincipalId` and `readGatedSessionUser` answer a session-admitted principal from the same record (`readGatedSessionUser` keeps its probe first, so an inactive gate still answers `undefined`).
- Comments made false by this change are corrected, including two comment-only lines in `packages/core` (`request-execution-context.ts` door table, `assemble-execution-context.ts` field doc) that said the dispatcher re-reads the session.

After: gate active, one dispatcher request reads the session once (2 to 1); a declared endpoint reads it once (3 to 1). Session controls (revocation, idle/absolute timeout) run inside that one read, as before; the IP allow-list is a transport middleware on the auth routes and is untouched.

## Tests

- New `http-dispatcher.session-read-once.pin.test.ts` (real kernel, `passwordExpiryDays: 365` so the gate is active): one warm request = 1 `sys_session` token lookup and 1 better-auth `sys_user` lookup. Controls: a held session (administrator-issued password change) is still 403 `PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED`; a revoked session (row deleted) answers 401; an anonymous request answers 401 and issues no `sys_session` statement; 8 interleaved concurrent requests with two tokens each get their own answer (200/403) and their own single read.
- `dispatcher-plugin.endpoint-fallback.integration.test.ts`, new top-level describe: a declared endpoint with the gate active is served on ONE getSession; a held session is still 403 with its code on one read; anonymous still 401; concurrent callers keep their own answers.
- `http-dispatcher.auth-gate-outage.pin.test.ts` CASE 2: its "an active gate reads once more" control now measures that on a caller the identity step did not admit (the gate still reads for it), and adds that a session-admitted principal costs no extra read, active or not.

<details><summary>Reverse verification (one-shot, implementation reverted to 97f342037d, tests at HEAD)</summary>

`git restore --source=97f342037d -- packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts`, then the two pin files: 5 failed / 26 passed.

- `expected { sys_session: 2, sys_user: 2 } to deeply equal { sys_session: 1, sys_user: 1 }` (warm request, and each concurrent request)
- `expected [ 'admin1', 'admin1', 'admin1' ] to deeply equal [ 'admin1' ]` (declared endpoint, 3 reads)
- anonymous and revoked controls green on both sides.

Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- …`; `git diff HEAD` empty and both blob hashes match HEAD.
</details>

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` (tsc + check:test-typecheck) exit 0; `vitest run --project local` 628/629 files, 11607 passed, 1 failed (the CASE 2 control above, since updated); the three edited/new files re-run at the final head: 3 files, 40 tests passed.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 73 families: 72 exit 0, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET (needs a full `pnpm build`; NOT MEASURED locally, CI runs it). `check:test-source-alias` first exit 1 (two edited test files reached a lazy `@objectstack/metadata` load), fixed with a module-top import, exit 0 at the final head with the other ratchet families.
- `overlap-check` clean; full dogfood not owed (no `!`, no narrowing arm).
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Rate limiter half (not in this PR).** With `server.security.rateLimit` armed, the inbound limiter reads the session in a transport middleware before every route. The Hono adapter's middleware seam runs the whole middleware chain to completion and only then calls the route, with a separate request object and no shared async scope, so nothing in `packages/runtime` can hand the limiter's read to the route without a cross-request cache (ruled out). It needs a per-request carrier at the transport (`plugin-hono-server`'s seam) or a core-owned request memo that every door's session read consults.
- **REST door, same family.** With a gate active, REST's identity step and core's `decideAuthGate` (`authGate: 'reread-when-active'`) each read the session: 2 reads per `/api/v1/data` request. Fix lives in `packages/core` / `packages/rest`, outside this claim.
- Accept set: unchanged. The one window that moves is a degenerate race: an identity read that succeeded followed by a gate re-read that failed used to answer 503; there is no second read now, so the posture from the successful read decides.
- New real-kernel test file pays the same composition import as the statements golden; no `test-budget` declared (no CI reading yet).

## Verification

Files to read first: `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts` (`enforceAuthGate`, the `sessionAdmittedPrincipal` branch), `packages/runtime/src/security/admitting-credential.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts` (fallback `resolvePrincipalId` / `readGatedSessionUser`).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/http-dispatcher.session-read-once.pin.test.ts` — expect 6 passed, including `reads sys_session once and the session user once`.
